cases.title: Logo completes then game remains on white screen

symptomFingerprint.primary: startup reaches/passes logo then white screen and does not progress into normal game flow
secondary: recenter/input path may still respond while presentation/game progression is stuck
logSignals: correlate game/host/watchdog session timeline around first post-logo Present and stereo transport activation

knownGood: a9abb85702925aaa09ca85581423eb9766c2adb3 — logo/menu/car/course/race rendered; later theater-only VR defect remained

rootCause.summary: D3D9Ex synchronous CreateDevice-thread stereo installation called EnsureStereoResources before the promoted device was returned to OutRun, allocating/mutating private RT/depth resources before fresh-device initialization completed.

fixReferences: 986f0d5794476056ef4bea08c6ac3c0d1f5f01d2 — historical protection: defer stereo resources until first successful game Present
341bd8027b9595f43c89e31ae1f9cf8783751faa — integrated current-focus reconstruction plus deterministic guard
revalidationTriggers: changes to host fallback/recovery or first-frame state
changes to launch/profile/config values affecting VR activation

verify deferred stereo resource initialization is absent from CreateDevice pre-exposure path and occurs only after successful game Present
runtime: confirm logo transitions into menu/game instead of persistent white frame
confirm gameplay stereo opens after deferred initialization
collect standardized OutRun2_VR_ANALYZE_*.zip if failure recurs

cases.nextAction: Run Quest3/VDXR CORRECTNESS validation: logo->menu/game without persistent white frame, then verify gameplay stereo opens. Keep case open until USER RUNTIME VERIFIED; if symptom recurs append REOPENED using this same key.

cases.title: Startup crash inside canonical SpriteNode queue entry after VR HUD semantic hook install

symptomFingerprint.primary: Immediate 0xC0000005 access violation inside OR2006C2C.EXE SpriteNode queue-entry instruction block after VRHudQueueSemanticBridge installs.
secondary: crash occurs before meaningful stereo runtime progression

knownGood: Any candidate where production code does not install a mid-hook at RVA 0x2D734; runtime verification still required for current fix.

rootCause.summary: Production SafetyHookMid installed at canonical queue-entry RVA 0x2D734. Two independent real crashes resumed inside that relocated entry instruction sequence (0x2D738 and 0x2D73E), proving this entry hook boundary unsafe.

fixReferences: vr-d3d9ex-candidate/VR-HUDQUEUE-ENTRY-CRASH-559eb670 — remove 0x2D734 mid-hook; lazily begin queue semantic ownership at first per-node hook RVA 0x2D762; keep epilogue 0x2DCB4
revalidationTriggers: any production hook added within the canonical SpriteNode queue entry/prologue 0x2D734..0x2D74A
any change to SpriteNode semantic queue lifetime/ownership

static: require semantic queue scope to start lazily at first per-node hook 0x2D762
build Win32 active game DLL and package
strict canonical EXE byte contract remains valid for static reverse-analysis anchors
runtime: confirm startup passes the prior crash point without OR2006C2C.EXE+0x2D738/0x2D73E exception
confirm HUD semantic path becomes active and collect standardized OutRun2_VR_ANALYZE_*.zip

cases.nextAction: Complete exact candidate CI/package, then run one short Quest3/VDXR CORRECTNESS startup/HUD test. Do not integrate any candidate containing a production 0x2D734 hook.

cases.title: Untagged SpriteNode queue draws are blanket-promoted to world-locked HUD and corrupt the scene

symptomFingerprint.primary: True stereo remains stable but the broad 3D scene is visibly corrupted.
secondary: R47 telemetry shows semanticHudAccepted equals hudWorldLock for every admitted XYZRHW HUD draw
independent HUD inspector resolves zero verified HUD semantics in the same session
logSignals: HUD_TRACE_SUMMARY rows=1334 with all expected semantics NOT_OBSERVED/UNKNOWN

knownBad: ea7c322d8a21f41e2055214abd28b68c28fbeb19 — stable stereo, user reports whole-screen visual corruption; blanket queue fallback active
9554272a7142b1533dfbf85d294111f3d6634fe1 — blanket finite-HUD promotion removed, but generic 2D queue fell to stock zero-disparity duplication and became binocularly split under asymmetric OpenXR FOV

rootCause.summary: ConsumeSpriteNodeScope defaulted every untagged canonical queue node to ScreenHud. Production R47 therefore treated queue membership itself as semantic HUD proof and applied the finite world-locked HUD plane to all such XYZRHW draws, contradicting the project's fail-closed unknown-draw policy and the independent HUD evidence stream.

fixReferences: 9554272a7142b1533dfbf85d294111f3d6634fe1 — removed blanket ScreenHud finite-plane ownership; runtime proved NONE fallback is too weak for asymmetric-FOV 2D convergence
vr-d3d9ex-candidate/VR-R50-QUEUE-FOV2D-9554272a — refined generic queue ownership to FOV-only ScreenOverlay2D; exact ScreenHud/WorldBillboard remain explicit
revalidationTriggers: changes that treat queue membership alone as ScreenHud
changes to XYZRHW HUD promotion/finite-plane ownership

static: forbid head inverse/IPD/depth reset for generic queue content
runtime: semanticUnknownRejected must become nonzero for untagged draws
no broad finite-plane promotion without explicit tag
remaining HUD defects are tracked separately rather than widening scope

cases.nextAction: Validate R50 exact candidate. Broad scene must stay free of finite-HUD distortion while generic 2D/HUD converges to one image.

cases.title: Generic 2D/HUD becomes double when untagged SpriteNode queue falls through to identical-pixel two-eye duplication

symptomFingerprint.primary: User reports everything split into two, including HUD, on exact 9554272a fail-closed candidate.
secondary: R30 HUD/2D ownership is completely zero while stereo transport remains healthy
generic SpriteNode draws fall through to R7/R9 non-world duplication with unchanged D3D screen coordinates
logSignals: R7 design duplicates non-world draws at stock WVP/screen coordinates
Quest/VDXR publishes asymmetric left/right FOV, so identical per-eye NDC/pixel positions do not represent the same visual ray
rightDraw/restore/present failures remain zero and DirectGPU true stereo is active

knownBad: 9554272a7142b1533dfbf85d294111f3d6634fe1 — user runtime confirms whole visible image/HUD diplopia after generic queue fallback=None

rootCause.summary: The 9554272a isolation correctly stopped finite-plane over-promotion, but untagged canonical 2D queue content then bypassed R30 completely. R7/R9 duplicates non-world draws with identical stock screen coordinates. Because the OpenXR left/right projection FOVs are asymmetric, identical D3D coordinates map to different visual rays and appear separated in the HMD.

fixReferences: vr-d3d9ex-candidate/VR-R50-QUEUE-FOV2D-9554272a — introduce ScreenOverlay2D and apply only the proven common-ray asymmetric-FOV affine to generic SpriteNode content; no head inverse, IPD translation, depth reset, HudScale or finite world plane
revalidationTriggers: changes to R30BuildEyeAffine or generic screen-space mapping
changes that apply finite HUD plane to ScreenOverlay2D
changes that send ScreenOverlay2D back to stock R7/R9 duplication

shader ScreenOverlay2D post-multiplies only a clip-space X FOV affine
no head inverse/IPD/depth reset/HudScale in generic overlay branch
runtime: generic HUD/2D must converge to one image
